title: Every identity tag carries a mapped material, a triplanar or a modelled asset
note: Every material on an identity tag carries a baked map, a triplanar projection or a modelled asset — a flat standard material is an untextured box.
intent: The check is written against the facet's own identity tags, not against everything in the scene: whatever the facet exists to build must not be flat colour. Three answers pass it — a baked map from the project's material baker, a triplanar projection for terrain and rock where UVs are painful, or a mesh loaded with loadAsset (which bakes a map onto any asset material that has none). Replace tags() in the check body with the facet's identity tag list when the plan writes it down, so a facet is measured on its own work rather than on the whole world.

check.js: (() => { const ids = (typeof identityTags !== 'undefined' ? identityTags : tags()).filter(t => t !== 'hud'); return ids.length > 0 && ids.every(t => materials(t).length > 0 && materials(t).every(m => m.map || m.userData?.triplanar || m.userData?.asset)); })()
check.note: Every material on the facet's identity tags has a map (baked by the project's material baker), a triplanar projection, or belongs to a modelled asset (userData.asset, stamped by the project's asset loader — it bakes a map onto any asset material that has none) — a flat MeshStandardMaterial is an untextured box. Replace tags() with the facet's identity tag list in the js.

port: The mainOwner bakes shared materials in one material module; every other facet applies one by tag and edits the check to name its own tags.
